cycles.trigger: The first focused run exposed one fixture-authority mismatch and one invalid negative-test mutation technique.
findings: The service compared fixture DB UUIDs against production activation UUIDs from the committed CH1 report even though package/profile/snapshot hashes were already revalidated directly in the active DB.
The negative test attempted to UPDATE an immutable ArtifactVersion row, so the database trigger rejected setup before the service could evaluate the mismatch.
repairs: Kept upstream report verdict checks while resolving and hashing exact profile, snapshot and package authority directly from current DB lineage.
Changed the negative test to corrupt only the SQLAlchemy identity-map read; no immutable database row is updated.
cycles.verification: Focused suite passed 3 tests; the required cross-phase suite passed 29 tests. Production approval passed on its first write attempt.

excluded_from_cycle_count: Sandbox localhost approvals are environment controls, not application repair cycles.
Production approval creation made zero provider, render, Drive, or YouTube calls and needed no repair.
